programs.title: Destination Flavour Japan Bitesize
programs.desc: Adam Liaw goes to sea with the Japanese fishermen who caught the 'million dollar tuna', and then meets the soy sauce maker who saved most of his staff from the 2011 tsunami.

programs.title: Ainsley's Great Garden Cook Off
programs.desc: Ainsley Harriott is joined by chefs Genevieve Taylor and Nico Reynolds at the kitchen garden of Tyntesfield in Somerset to see who can create and cook the Dish of the Day.

programs.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams
programs.desc: For the perfect skewers, Alimah was taught to imagine she was sewing a running stitch when threading the skewer through the meat. She shares an Island Dreams satay favourite.

programs.title: Kriol Kitchen
programs.sub_title: Patty Mamid: Creamy Chilli Squid & Soybean Seafood Soup
programs.desc: Patty Mamid shows us how to prepare creamy chilli squid and soybean seafood soup. Drawing on her multicultural heritage, Patty cooks up two dishes of her own making.

programs.title: Marcus Wareing's Kitchen Garden Tales
programs.desc: Marcus checks on the new pine forest he's planted, and experiments on using pine in his cooking. He's also keen on expanding his livestock collection with some commercial pigs.

programs.title: My Market Kitchen
programs.desc: Matt is at the exclusive Makepeace Resort Island in Queensland, making XO Sauce for crispy fried eggs. Mike creates a healthy breakfast, chia coconut porridge.
